release_notes:
## This is a beta version intended for testing only. Expect breaking changes in updates. Normal users are advised to wait for the stable release.

### Source Cloud Connect & Disconnect
- In-app disconnect with confirmation dialog for Real-Debrid and TorBox
- In-app API-key connect path alongside QR fallback (paste from clipboard support)
- Per-service row shows Connected/Disconnected state and offers appropriate action
- Removed "coming soon" placeholder; renamed advanced config to "Open advanced configuration"

### Stream Preferences
- Profile-scoped DataStore for stream resolution, codec, HDR, and audio preferences
- Pure filter+sort engine over Stream sourceCloudMetadata
- Stream preferences settings screen with picker dialogs
- Autoplay selector now consults stream preferences
- Stream picker applies filter+sort prefs with quick toggles

### Other Fixes
- Push unsynced local changes immediately after remote pull
- Guard cached enrichment by season+episode to clear stale thumbnails
- Compute remaining time from progress percent when position missing
- Accept Trakt history entries as Continue Watching seeds; mirror progress to sync
- Regional English TMDB locales, aggregate TV credits, English fallback
- Force highest HLS bitrate from first segment in trailers
- Shared single/multi-choice picker dialogs for settings
